messages:
liz_customer: Hi team — we're hitting intermittent JSON parse failures from the /v1/generate endpoint when using JSON mode. The output sometimes has extra keys in some objects and sometimes omits required 'id' fields. Our consumer throws and then we retry which caused billing churn. Repro steps below.

maria_support: Thanks @liz — can you paste the request_id and a sample response? Also are you pinning a model or using the default hosted model?

liz_customer: request_id: req_0a1b2c3d, model: rwd-1-large, json_mode: true. cURL we used:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-1-large","json_mode":true,"prompt":"[redacted]","max_tokens":512,"stream":false}'
```

liz_customer: sample response (truncated):
```json
{
  "items": [
    {"id":"itm_1","value":{"name":"Alice","tags":[{"k":"env","v":"prod"}]}}
    ,{"value":{"name":"Bob"},"extra_meta":"unexpected"}
    ,{"id":"itm_3","value":null}
  ]
}
```

ethan_oncall: assigning to @tom_engineer @nina_ml — this looks like schema drift or generation truncation. Also noting customer saw billing spikes from retries.

tom_engineer: looking. Can you confirm the full raw body (no pretty-print) and whether this was streamed or not? Also any client-side concatenation?

liz_customer: raw body (single-line) pasted: `{"items":[{"id":"itm_1","value":{"name":"Alice","tags":[{"k":"env","v":"prod"}]}}{"value":{"name":"Bob"},"extra_meta":"unexpected"},{"id":"itm_3","value":null}]}` — notice missing comma between first and second items.

nina_ml: That pattern looks like a streaming boundary or token merge issue. Even with stream=false our internal chunk emitter might sometimes drop punctuation when model output crosses internal chunk boundaries. Need a reproducible stream capture.

maria_support: I'm escalating to eng-runtime and eng-ml. @sre_bot please create an incident. We also need billing flagged for retries.

ops_bot: Incident created: INC-2026-042 (priority: P2) — assigned to oncall.

 tom_engineer: Repro steps I'd like to run: 1) repeat with `stream=true` and capture all chunks, 2) run with `max_tokens` set to 64 / 256 / 1024 to see length thresholds, 3) include `json_mode_schema` in request so model must conform to validator wrapper. Can @liz run `stream=true` and paste chunked output?

liz_customer: ran `stream=true` — chunk sequence below:
```
1: {"items":[{"id":"itm_1","value":{"name":"Alice","tags":[{"k":"env","v":"prod"}]}}
2: {"value":{"name":"Bob"},"extra_meta":"unexpected"},
3: {"id":"itm_3","value":null}]
```
Chunks show chunk1 ends without a trailing comma and chunk2 starts without a leading comma which breaks client concat parsing.

nina_ml: confirmed. That strongly suggests our chunk framing isn't inserting or preserving delimiters in edge cases. Could be tokenizer/truncation behavior in kernel that merges '}}' with following token.

tom_engineer: I reproduced this locally against rwd-1-large:v12 with the kernel used by the runtime. There's an off-by-one in the chunk joiner when the model emits punctuation as the next-token boundary. I'll push a fix to the runtime to ensure separators are emitted when json_mode is enabled. Preparing a patch.

liz_customer: thanks — also can you please refund the retries? We did ~40 retry calls before we caught the pattern.

maria_support: Filed billing dispute #BD-8912 for potential credits and asked finance to review.

finance_bot: Noted, will review and respond within 2 business days.

 tom_engineer: Patch branch `fix/json-mode-chunk-sep` created. Running unit + integration tests now. Plan: canary deploy in 2 hours.

ethan_oncall: please gate the change behind a feature flag so we can toggle quickly if something unexpected appears.

 tom_engineer: added feature flag `enable_json_chunk_separator` (default: true for canary). Will monitor error rates and logs.

maria_support: I'll keep the customer updated and post canary results here. :thumbsup:
